adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts` the new `updateEvent` fallback sets `selectedCalendar` to `externalCalendarId ? externalCalendarId : event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId;`. When `externalCalendarId` is falsy (the only time the fallback branch runs), the `.find` compares `cal.externalId` to that same falsy value (likely `undefined`/`null`), so it will not match real calendar IDs and returns `undefined`. This effectively removes the previous behavior (fallback to the event’s destination calendar) and can cause updates (and similarly deletes in the same file) to target an undefined calendarId / wrong default behavior.
